module.purpose: Provides host normalization, routing filters, delegation-credential enrichment, and round-robin segment matching for booking event types.
module.summary: This module prepares booking hosts for downstream scheduling flows. It filters routed users while preserving fixed users and contact owners, normalizes explicit hosts versus fallback users, enriches hosts with delegation credentials, and restricts round-robin hosts using team-member attribute segmentation. It supports both synchronous transformations and asynchronous organization, credential, and segmentation lookups.
module.businessContext: Supports Cal.com team booking and round-robin assignment. Failures can route bookings to incorrect hosts, omit eligible members, or prevent delegated credentials from being used.
functions: getRoutedUsersWithContactOwnerAndFixedUsers (~L15-38): Filters users according to routed members and booking exceptions

moduleContractTests.scenario: No routed team member IDs are supplied.
moduleContractTests.rationale: Preserves the regular booking flow when routing constraints are absent.

moduleContractTests.scenario: Users include routed members, fixed users, a contact owner, and unrelated users.
given: users = [{ id: 1, email: "a@example.com" }, { id: 2, isFixed: true, email: "b@example.com" }, { id: 3, email: "owner@example.com" }, { id: 4, email: "other@example.com" }]
moduleContractTests.then: returns users with ids 1, 2, and 3 in their original order
moduleContractTests.rationale: Pins the inclusive filtering rules for routed, fixed, and contact-owner users.

moduleContractTests.scenario: An event has a scheduling type and configured hosts.
given: eventType.hosts = [{ isFixed: true, user, priority: 1, weight: 2, weightAdjustment: 3, createdAt }]
moduleContractTests.then: returns hosts containing isFixed, user, priority, weight, and createdAt, with fallbackHosts equal to null
moduleContractTests.rationale: Guards the normalized host shape and configured-host branch.

moduleContractTests.scenario: An event has no usable configured hosts.
moduleContractTests.then: returns hosts equal to null and fallbackHosts containing the user with isFixed true and createdAt null
moduleContractTests.rationale: Pins fallback host construction for collective scheduling.

moduleContractTests.scenario: Segment matching is enabled and the attribute query returns a subset of team members.
given: eventType.team = { id: 10, parentId: 20, rrResetInterval: null, rrTimestampBasis }
moduleContractTests.then: returns only hosts whose user.id is included in matchingRRTeamMembers
moduleContractTests.rationale: Verifies segment membership is applied to round-robin hosts.
